title: SHA-1 use via Digest::SHA1.hexdigest (ruby) — review required
description: The ruby call Digest::SHA1.hexdigest computes SHA-1, which is deprecated for security purposes (collision attacks are practical for well-funded attackers and improving). It is unacceptable for signatures or integrity of untrusted data. This lexical rule cannot tell the use case — treat every hit as review-required.
remediation: Use Digest::SHA256.hexdigest for any security purpose. Keep SHA-1 only for compatibility shims and checksums with a comment saying so.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches any Digest::SHA1.hexdigest call regardless of purpose. Name-selected SHA-1 and other weak algorithms are separate rules.
